info.title: BetterMQ API
info.description: HTTP message broker — publish, queues, enqueue, flow control, cron, and DLQ. Authenticate with a panel-generated `sk_local_…` Bearer token.

AdminFailure.description: Invalid management request or rejected controller operation

AdminResult.description: Management operation result; includes operation-specific fields and probe diagnostics

bearerAuth.description: API token for data-plane requests (`Authorization: Bearer sk_local_…`); administrator session token for embedded management or cluster-secret bearer for standalone management.

dlq.description: Exact node-local retained count only when dlq_ready=true; null during recovery and on Slate.

dlq_count_reason.description: Slate reports 'count unavailable on this storage backend'. Local WAL recovery reports its initialization status; partial counts are not presented as exact.

PublishBody.description: Publish to a URL (url+secret) or fan-out to a group (group_id). Exactly one destination mode.

url.description: Direct destination URL (mutually exclusive with group_id)

flow_id.description: Pre-created flow profile (direct publish only). Prefer inline flowControl.

flowControl.description: Alias for flow — ensure/reuse profile by key on publish

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds (applies to url and group_id)

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

headers.description: Outbound headers as an object map, or curl-style array of [name, value] / "Name: value" strings

body_encoding.description: Optional encoding hint for body (e.g. base64)

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

EnqueueBody.description: Enqueue a job. Omit `key` for standard delivery (queue parallelism). Set `key` for FIFO per entity. Retries default from the queue.

key.description: Optional FIFO lane. Empty/omit = standard. Same key is ordered; different keys run in parallel.

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

headers.description: Outbound headers as an object map, or curl-style array of [name, value] / "Name: value" strings

body_encoding.description: Optional encoding hint for body (e.g. base64)

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

fanout_id.description: Durable fan-out identity. Unaccepted members are replayed by the broker; preserve the original idempotency key when retrying the same command.

partial.description: True when group member attempts produced mixed outcomes.
True when accepted and failed items coexist. Retry only failed items marked retryable, preserving their idempotency keys.

code.description: Stable failure code; present only on failures.

retryable.description: Retry only failed items with retryable=true. Retain idempotency keys because infrastructure failures can have an ambiguous commit outcome.

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

RetryBackoff.description: Backoff between delivery attempts. JSON keys are camelCase (kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier) matching the broker wire format.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation including partition and next offset, bound to this DLQ topic. Continue even if messages is empty; null marks the end.

reason.description: Why the message was moved to the DLQ (HTTP status, transport error, retries exhausted, …)

count_unavailable_reason.description: Slate: count unavailable on this storage backend. Also explains local recovery in progress. No partial count is returned.

accepted.description: Whether this member was committed or scheduled.

CreateQueueBody.description: Named destination. Retries and parallelism apply to new enqueues. Changing the URL does not affect in-flight jobs.

parallelism.description: Max in-flight for jobs without a key. 1 = serial queue. Omit or 0 = unconstrained (standard).

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

parallelism.description: Max in-flight for jobs without a key. Omitted = unconstrained.

paused.description: When true, fan-out publish skips all members of this group

flow_key.description: Set to null to clear the member flow_key

paused.description: When true, this member is skipped during group fan-out

FlowControlBody.description: Inline flow control on publish. Reuses an existing profile when key + limits match; otherwise creates or updates. Also accepted as `flow`. Queue jobs do not use this — set a message `key` for FIFO or queue `parallelism` for standard.

key.description: Flow-control key. Defaults to the message routing key when omitted.

parallelism.description: Max concurrent in-flight deliveries for this key

rate.description: Max deliveries started per period. 0 = no rate limit.

period_secs.description: Rate window in seconds. Alias: period.

applied_nodes.description: Nodes that confirmed this action; not a fleet-wide acknowledgement.

shared_metadata.description: Shared-metadata peers may observe changes asynchronously.

cron.description: 5- or 6-field cron. UTC by default. Prefix with CRON_TZ=<IANA> for a local timezone, e.g. CRON_TZ=America/New_York */5 * * * *.

key.description: When targeting a queue: FIFO lane. Omit for standard.

body_encoding.description: Optional encoding hint for body (e.g. base64)

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

headers.description: Outbound headers as an object map, or curl-style array of [name, value] / "Name: value" strings

next_cursor.description: Opaque exclusive delivery-deadline and schedule-id continuation. Null marks the end.

total.description: Maintained pending count including in-flight scheduled jobs.

HttpDeliveryInput.description: Optional nested curl-style outbound overrides on publish/enqueue/cron

UpsertFlowControlBody.description: Body for PUT /v1/flow/{key}. Path supplies the key; do not send key here.

setup_open.description: First-boot password can be set during the setup window

setup_closes_in_secs.description: Seconds left on the first-boot window

internal_url.description: Private peer URL; defaults to public_url when absent.

S3Config.description: camelCase S3 settings (storage update body / config view)

secretKey.description: Send •••••••• to keep the existing secret

listen.description: Optional. When omitted, preserve the saved listener unchanged.

get.description: Bounded payload-free metadata ordered by delivery deadline and id. Includes jobs in flight until durable completion. Follow next_cursor until null; counts come from maintained scheduler state.

get.description: Node-local retained records, including legacy hash placement and source-shard-pinned records. Not a cluster-wide snapshot. Each request scans at most 512 records, stops after approximately 8 MiB matching payload bytes (one oversized record may exceed that), and returns no bodies by default. Empty pages may have next_cursor: continue until null. Works on Slate even though exact Slate counts are unavailable.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque partition/offset continuation bound to the selected DLQ topic

parameters.name: include_body
parameters.description: Opt in to bodies; otherwise fetch an individual body from /v1/dlq/message

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Primary queue name (`jobs` → `jobs.__dlq`).

parameters.name: dlq_topic
parameters.description: Full DLQ topic (`__direct.__dlq`, `__group.{id}.{member}.__dlq`, …). Use when not a named queue.

parameters.name: x-bettermq-cluster-challenge
parameters.description: Nonce from the joiner. When the seed has BETTERMQ_CLUSTER_SECRET set, it answers with x-bettermq-cluster-proof = hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "bettermq-seed-proof-v1\n" + nonce). Joiners with a cluster secret refuse seeds that do not prove it.

post.summary: Register a node into the cluster (join handshake)
Join a cluster on behalf of the panel attach flow
post.description: Same as /v1/infra/cluster/join, on the public router. A node with local auth configured requires its own API token (Authorization: Bearer). An unconfigured node requires x-bettermq-enroll-proof = `<unix_ms>.<hex HMAC-SHA256(BETTERMQ_CLUSTER_SECRET, "bettermq-enroll-v1\n" + unix_ms + "\n" + raw body)>`, at most 5 minutes old. Rejected on dispatch-fleet processes.
